title: World Health Organization
definition: The World Health Organization (WHO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health, established on 7 April 1948 with its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (International Organizations, health indices, funding mechanisms, statutory conventions) and Mains GS Paper II (Global governance, multilateral bodies, health diplomacy, and pandemic management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of World Health Organization.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of international relations and global health governance
